ValidationRule.description: Restrict the file types that can be uploaded to salesforce
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.Name != 'CFaaS File', !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.tiff'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.tif'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.jpeg'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.jpg'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.gif'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.bmp'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.png'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.pdf'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.doc'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.docx'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.xls'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.xlsx'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.xlsb'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.ppt'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.pptx'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 5) = '.json'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.msg'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.eml'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.rtf'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.txt'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.csv'), !(RIGHT( LOWER(PathOnClient) , 4) = '.zip'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This file has a file type which is not supported by CMOS. Please note it is not possible to load this file onto CMOS
